title: Credit Policy Reconnection Terms for Electric Service by Rate Schedule: Amount Owed for Reconnection
content:
**Terms.** The amount owed for reconnection of an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account disconnected for nonpayment depends on the account's collection history over the twelve whole months before the current date: whether a reconnect fee and whether a returned payment are dated in those months. "The notice amount" is the past-due amount the disconnect notice demands; "the month" is the span of dates less than one whole month before the current date.

| Reconnect fee dated in the twelve months | Returned payment dated in the twelve months | Amount owed for reconnection |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | The whole current account balance, with the payments of the month added back and the returned payments of the month taken off |
| Yes | No | The notice amount, plus every usage line, program charge line, late payment charge and fee dated in the month, less the bill credits dated in the month |
| No | Yes | The notice amount, plus the late payment charges and fees dated in the month, less the bill credits dated in the month |
| No | No | The notice amount |

### Hypothetical worked case

Records of the month: usage lines $142.30; no program charge; one late payment charge $4.30; one returned payment fee $30.00; one bill credit $12.00; payments $80.00; one returned payment $80.00. Notice amount $286.40; current account balance $731.00.

| History in the twelve months | Amount owed |
|---|---|
| Reconnect fee and returned payment | $731.00 plus $80.00 less $80.00, $731.00 |
| Reconnect fee only | $286.40 plus $142.30, $4.30 and $30.00, less $12.00, $451.00 |
| Returned payment only | $286.40 plus $4.30 and $30.00, less $12.00, $308.70 |
| Neither | $286.40 |

### Points of reading

- The reconnect fees and returned payments looked at are those of the same service account dated less than twelve whole months before the current date.
- In the first row the balance is taken as it stands today, with the month's payments put back and the month's returned payments removed.
